question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Ridicule
solution:
The correct answer is "**Derision**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ridicule **means to mock or make fun of someone or something in a contemptuous or sarcastic manner. (उपहास करना)
 
• **Pathology **refers to the study of diseases and their effects on the body. (रोग-विज्ञान, विकृति विज्ञान)
 
• **Resolute **means determined and unwavering in purpose or opinion. (दृढ़, कृतसंकल्प, अटल)
 
• Derision means contemptuous ridicule or mockery. (उपहास,हास्यास्पद)
 
• **Derivation **refers to the process of obtaining something from a source or origin. (व्युत्पत्ति, उत्पत्ति)
 
• From the meanings of all the words, it is clear that "**Derision**" is the most appropriate synonym for "**ridicule**".
 
• Hence, option 3 is correct.

31:T545,
The erroneous part is: **option 4**.
